name: quoted-csv-and-xml-escaping
description: A text/csv attachment with a quoted value containing a comma and XML special characters: DataWeave's CSV reader unquotes the value and the XML writer escapes '&', '<' and '>'. orders.xml is overwritten by the newest message.
